fusions.name: Second Edge Follows
fusions.desc: A follow-up cut that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Thrown Off-Hand
fusions.desc: Throws the off-hand blade at the first enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 16 damage and using up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Blade Under the Cloak
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Hidden Follow-Through
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
